about_short_description.short_description: Spenmo is an expense management platform that empowers finance teams to make smarter financial decisions.

product.name: Bill Management
product.description: A service that automates bill processing by using smart scanning, accounting software integration, and custom approval workflows to reduce manual effort and errors.

product.name: Corporate Debit Card
product.description: Provides access to physical and virtual Visa debit cards issued via licensed payment service providers for controlled business spending and reimbursements.

product.name: Reimbursements
product.description: A service to disburse employee expense claims quickly with multi-level approval processes to ensure policy compliance and reduce petty cash usage.

product.name: Accounting Software Integration
product.description: Integrates with accounting software like Xero, Netsuite, Quickbooks, and Jurnal to synchronize spend data and accelerate financial reconciliation.
